notes: The address is specifically to fathers. The verb rendered ‘nurture’ is also used in 5:29.
The Greek names slaves and masters, not employees and employers. ‘Earthly masters’ is literally ‘masters according to the flesh.’
‘Flesh and blood’ refers to human beings. The repeated ‘against’ distinguishes the powers named as the opponents.
‘Readiness’ can also carry the sense of preparation or a firm foundation. The good news is explicitly characterized by peace.
The final phrase literally means ‘in incorruptibility.’ It can describe undying love or the imperishable life in which the love belongs.
vocabulary: Eye-service: service performed only while watched.
